description: Get a signed PUT URL for uploading a community video. Business and community refer to the same thing and are interchangeable. Before offering this action or requesting its inputs, check business permissions. FREE businesses cannot use this tool, regardless of individual feature rows. Call check_business_tool_access before collecting inputs. Show any grace-period warning and verified resubscribe link before continuing, and never proceed when access is blocked.

checkpointId.description: Challenge checkpoint ID, from the challenge checkpoint list.

communityId.description: Nas.com business (community) ID. Use an ID returned by list_businesses or another Nas.com tool; never invent one.

entityType.description: Type of product or entity this action targets.

mailType.description: Email template type to read or update.

mimetype.description: MIME type of the file; use one of the allowed values.

originalname.description: Original file name of the upload.

participantId.description: Challenge participant ID, from a challenge participant listing.

name: get_community_video_presigned_url
title: Get Business Video Presigned URL
